description: Everything about a wallet in one call: total value with price status, top coins, DeFi and launchpad positions, SuiNS names and labels, who first funded it, its trading record and its latest transactions. Use it first for any question about an address or a .sui name. Example: { address: "example.sui" }.

address.description: A Sui address (0x...), a SuiNS name like example.sui, or @example.

name: wallet_profile
title: Profile a wallet
